title: How To Throw A Butter Pairings Party
summary: Would you believe us if we told you all you need to create a fun party is some butter?
body_markdown:
Would you believe us if we told you all you need to create a fun party is some butter? Prep a few unique types of butter then invite your friends over and have them each bring something delicious to pair with butter! Below are a few flavorful combos to get you started but sky’s the limit here. Use your imagination and have fun!


## Fresh + Herby


Mix fresh chopped herbs such as rosemary, thyme or oregano into softened Vital Farms Salted Butter.
Pair with sourdough bread, grilled steak or boiled potatoes.


## Simply Softened


Spread softened Vital Farms Unsalted Butter onto a plate and sprinkle with flaky salt to pair with radishes or baguette, cornichon and thinly sliced French ham to make mini jambon beurre sandwiches.


## Garlic + Chive


Stir grated garlic and finely chopped chives into melted Vital Farms Salted Butter and serve with soft pretzels or to drizzle over popcorn.


## Put A Bow On It


Don’t forget to send everyone home with a little party favor: a box or two of their very own Vital Farms Butter!


## Some Other Pairing Ideas


- Have someone bring a spirit such as whiskey or rum and make a hot buttered rum mix to serve!
- Combine softened Vital Farms Salted Butter with cinnamon and granulated sugar for a sweet spread
- Stir chili powder, parmesan cheese and lime zest into softened Vital Farms Salted Butter to spread over grilled corn
- Stir together cooled Vital Farms Salted Butter that’s been browned with honey for an indulgent pairing with cornbread or biscuits
- Whisk melted Vital Farms Salted Butter with your favorite hot sauce for an instant wing dip
